purpose: Phase 2 shared evaluator/runtime decision contract; no behavior or threshold change in Phase 1

decision_fields.policy_id: Named/versioned policy, required; never inferred from calibration being disabled
decision_fields.proof_eligible: boolean from full public proof/source-action gate
decision_fields.final_action: ANSWER | PARTIAL | ABSTAIN | REJECT, or null when serving stages are NOT_RUN
decision_fields.acceptance_basis: explicit policy ID plus gates satisfied
decision_fields.reason_codes: ordered per-output reasons, retaining all failed and unknown required obligations
decision_fields.output_id: stable request output ID; diagnostic synthetic IDs must be labeled separately

invariants: No flat-unique-proof override of DISABLED/UNCALIBRATED policy under the policy-calibrated policy
UNKNOWN required source proof remains ABSTAIN; INVALID evidence retains existing source rejection semantics
NOT_RUN never becomes VALID or an accepted serving answer
No numerical provisional result in non-answer payloads
Gold annotations and correctness metrics never enter runtime decision
Proof-only release, if later requested, requires a separate named policy and independent evaluation

multi_output.some_outputs_verified: PARTIAL; retain IDs, proof, certificate and citations for verified outputs
multi_output.none_verified: ABSTAIN or REJECT according to source rejection semantics
multi_output.measurement: Per-output acceptance and whole-request completeness reported separately

adoption_tests: Replay current disabled-policy divergence fixtures as expected rejection under new policy
Scalar, CLI, API, multi-output, evaluator share the decision object
Missing unit/period, wrong entity, multiple valid mappings and zero denominator fail closed
Certificate tampering rejected after exact replay
Policy-calibrated and separately evaluated proof-only metrics never merged
open_work: Decide source REJECT vs ABSTAIN reason mapping by preserving current contract tests
Implement only after Phase 1 diagnosis is frozen
Measure end-to-end behavior before any release claim
